exposure: UK Supreme Court decision in Montgomery v Lanarkshire Health Board
Legal duty to disclose material risks
Legal duty to disclose reasonable alternative or variant treatments
outcome: Incorporation of Montgomery into local professional code and case law
cohort: This article analyzes legal precedents related to risk disclosure and informed consent involving doctors and patients, specifically surgeons in the consent process.
finding: Following the Montgomery decision, doctors have a legal duty to inform patients of material risks and alternative treatments, requiring surgeons to adapt their consent practices to minimize legal risks.
